question: What fraction of the observed one-b-tag events is estimated to be background?
expect: 2,630 / 21,666 = 12.1% (Table 2, p5); consistent with the ~88% purity in the text
rendered: Table 2 shows the observed numbers of opposite-sign eμ events with one and two b-tagged jets, together with the estimates of backgrounds and associated total uncertainties. The total background fraction for one b-tagged events is estimated to be 34% (2630/7766).
